visual_action: Kamala Harris stands outdoors in front of a large blue bus with white lettering. She is speaking and gesturing to an unseen person off-camera.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the sole person on screen and is speaking throughout the video.

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris asks someone off-screen a series of questions about voting: "Did you vote? Are you gonna vote?" When the person seems to indicate they won't, she asks them to encourage others to vote, and then smilingly adds, "And will you ask them to vote for me?"
audio_music: A modern hip-hop/trap track with vocals and a beat plays consistently throughout the video, creating an energetic and contemporary mood.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, uncut shot focused on Kamala Harris speaking.
central_claim: Kamala Harris is personally and directly asking people to vote and to get others to vote for her.
intended_effect: To portray Kamala Harris as relatable and actively engaged in get-out-the-vote efforts, using a lighthearted moment to encourage viewers to support her.
uncertainty_flags: The full text on the side of the bus is not clearly legible.
